integrity: Enumeration and cross-check scripts with standard-library dependencies are supplied; no external or independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for nonempty finite structures with exactly three named equivalence predicates and size at most six; computer-assisted exact census, not an all-size classification. The 2015 general C2 classification provides broader theory and examples, making priority of the explicit finite table a residual risk.
title: A three-point transversal completes the six-element \(C^2\) classification for three equivalences
